title: Why Adnan Syed Was Released From Prison

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访几位在商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、

sentences.en: Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、扎伊兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 您可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Yesterday, Adnan Syed was released from prison.
sentences.zh: 昨天，阿德南·赛义德获释出狱。

sentences.en: You know his story.
sentences.zh: 你们都知道他的故事。

sentences.en: It was the subject of the first season of the podcast Serial, which painstakingly examined his case and the evidence used against him.
sentences.zh: 他曾是播客《Serial》第一季的主题，该节目详尽地审查了他的案件以及针对他的证据。

sentences.en: Syed was accused of killing his classmate and ex-girlfriend, Heimin Lee, whose body was found buried in a park in Baltimore.
sentences.zh: 赛义德被指控杀害了他的同学兼前女友李海敏，她的尸体在巴尔的摩的一个公园里被发现。

sentences.en: He was convicted and sentenced to life, but has proclaimed his innocence for the last 23 years.
sentences.zh: 他被判处终身监禁，但在过去的23年里，他一直坚称自己是无辜的。

sentences.en: It was a stunning development, and my colleague, serial host Sarah Koenig, was in court watching it unfold, and tells the story of why it happened.
sentences.zh: 这是一个令人震惊的进展，我的同事、《Serial》的主持人莎拉·凯尼格在法庭上目睹了这一切，并讲述了这件事发生的原因。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, September 20th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月20日，星期二。

sentences.en: This is a Global Tell Link prepaid call from
sentences.zh: 这是一通来自全球电话链接的预付费电话，拨打者是

sentences.en: Adnan Syed.
sentences.zh: 阿德南·赛义德。

sentences.en: An inmate at a Maryland correctional facility.
sentences.zh: 马里兰州一所惩教设施的囚犯。

sentences.en: This call will be recorded and monitored.
sentences.zh: 此通话将被录音和监控。

sentences.en: There is a major development in a case intimately explored in the Hick Podcast Serial.
sentences.zh: 在播客《Serial》深入探讨的一起案件中，出现了重大进展。

sentences.en: A stunning reversal.
sentences.zh: 一个惊人的反转。

sentences.en: Baltimore State's attorney presenting new evidence of two other possible suspects.
sentences.zh: 巴尔的摩州检察官提出了两名其他潜在嫌疑人的新证据。

sentences.en: And what this all means is that after decades behind bars, Adnan could be released from prison.
sentences.zh: 这意味着在铁窗后度过几十年后，阿德南可能获释出狱。

sentences.en: Adnan Syed got out of prison yesterday.
sentences.zh: 阿德南·赛义德昨天出狱了。

sentences.en: It was extraordinary, the whole thing.
sentences.zh: 这一切都非同寻常。

sentences.en: Here's his attorney, Erika Suter.
sentences.zh: 这是他的律师埃里卡·苏特。

sentences.en: Today, my friend and client Adnan Syed walks free for the first time in 23 years.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的朋友兼客户阿德南·赛义德在23年来第一次重获自由。

sentences.en: On Wednesday of last week, city prosecutors filed a motion saying they could no longer stand behind the murder case they built against Adnan.
sentences.zh: 上周三，市检察官提交了一份动议，称他们无法再支持针对阿德南的谋杀指控。

sentences.en: They were asking a judge to vacate the conviction.
sentences.zh: 他们请求法官撤销定罪。

sentences.en: Five days later, Adnan was out.
sentences.zh: 五天后，阿德南获释了。

sentences.en: On home detention for now, but out.
sentences.zh: 目前处于居家监禁中，但已经出来了。

sentences.en: Home.
sentences.zh: 回家了。

sentences.en: Good afternoon.
sentences.zh: 下午好。

sentences.en: God is good.
sentences.zh: 上帝是仁慈的。

sentences.en: Since the inception of my administration...
sentences.zh: 自本届政府成立以来……

sentences.en: Marilyn Mosby, Baltimore State's attorney, started to give a statement to the dozens of TV cameras and microphones masked on the sidewalk outside the courthouse.
sentences.zh: 巴尔的摩州检察官玛丽琳·莫斯比开始向法院外人行道上聚集的数十台电视摄像机和麦克风发表声明。

sentences.en: The public must know that the justice...
sentences.zh: 公众必须知道正义……

sentences.en: But she couldn't compete with the mayhem when Adnan finally walked out.
sentences.zh: 但当阿德南最终走出来时，她无法与现场的混乱相抗衡。

sentences.en: From the people who've been arguing for his release, some of them for decades, the pent-up strain of years' worth of rage and frustration suddenly loosed on the sidewalk,
sentences.zh: 对于那些一直为他获释而奔走的人来说，有些人甚至奔走了几十年，多年来积压的愤怒和沮丧突然在人行道上释放出来，

sentences.en: spilling onto Calvert Street.
sentences.zh: 涌向卡尔弗特街。

sentences.en: Adnan didn't say a word, just kept his cool while sheriff's deputies hurried him through the scrum and into a white van.
sentences.zh: 阿德南一言不发，在治安官副手护送他穿过人群并进入一辆白色货车时，他保持着冷静。

sentences.en: Adnan and I have talked on and off over the years.
sentences.zh: 多年来，我和阿德南断断续续地交谈过。

sentences.en: More recently, it seemed like he was trying to tamp down his hopes, not get ahead of himself.
sentences.zh: 最近，他似乎在努力压抑自己的希望，不想操之过急。

sentences.en: A couple of his old attorneys, though, the guys who tried to get him out on bail when he was 17, I caught them out on the sidewalk, hugging.
sentences.zh: 不过，我看到他以前的两位律师，也就是他在17岁时试图帮他保释的那几个人，在人行道上拥抱在一起。

sentences.en: I was in the courtroom for the hearing.
sentences.zh: 我当时在法庭听证会上。

sentences.en: More than 100 people, at times shockingly quiet, as if no one was breathing.
sentences.zh: 现场有100多人，有时安静得令人震惊，仿佛没人敢呼吸。

sentences.en: At the beginning, Young Lee, the brother of Heyman Lee, whose murder was about to be unsolved, spoke via Zoom directly to Judge Melissa Finn.
sentences.zh: 起初，李海敏的兄弟李永通过Zoom直接向梅丽莎·芬恩法官发言，而李海敏的谋杀案即将成为悬案。

sentences.en: Young Lee tried to keep it together, but he couldn't.
sentences.zh: 李永试图控制情绪，但他做不到。

sentences.en: When I think it's over, he said, it always comes back.
sentences.zh: 他说，当我以为一切都结束时，它总是会卷土重来。

sentences.en: A real-life living nightmare for 20-plus years.
sentences.zh: 这对他来说是20多年来现实生活中的噩梦。

sentences.en: But he also told the judge he believes in the justice system.
sentences.zh: 但他同时也告诉法官，他相信司法系统。

sentences.en: He's not against a new investigation.
sentences.zh: 他不反对重新调查。

sentences.en: He said to Judge Finn, make the right decision.
sentences.zh: 他对芬恩法官说，请做出正确的决定。

sentences.en: Then the prosecutor read the highlights of her motion into the record.
sentences.zh: 随后，检察官将动议的要点读入记录。

sentences.en: Adnan's lawyer made a brief statement.
sentences.zh: 阿德南的律师发表了简短的声明。

sentences.en: And within about 40 minutes, the judge was ready with her decision.
sentences.zh: 大约40分钟内，法官就准备好了她的决定。

sentences.en: On this 19th day of September, 2022, she said, in the interests of justice, the motion to vacate is hereby granted.
sentences.zh: 她说，在2022年9月19日这一天，为了司法公正，撤销定罪的动议特此批准。

sentences.en: You might be asking, what on earth happened?
sentences.zh: 你可能会问，到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: I've spent the last few days trying to understand it myself.
sentences.zh: 过去几天我自己也在努力弄明白。

sentences.en: Wherefore, this motion to vacate that burst like a firework out of the prosecutor's office?
sentences.zh: 为什么这份撤销动议会像烟花一样从检察官办公室爆发出来？

sentences.en: The very same office that asked the jury in 1999 to, quote, come back with a guilty finding for first-degree premeditated murder by the defendant, Adnan Syed.
sentences.zh: 正是同一个办公室，曾在1999年要求陪审团，引用原话，“带回被告阿德南·赛义德犯有一级蓄意谋杀罪的裁决”。

sentences.en: The prosecutors today are not saying Adnan is innocent.
sentences.zh: 今天的检察官并没有说阿德南是无辜的。

sentences.en: They stop short of exonerating him.
sentences.zh: 他们没有完全为他平反。

sentences.en: Instead, they're saying that back in 1999, we didn't investigate this case thoroughly enough.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们说在1999年，我们对这个案件的调查不够彻底。

sentences.en: We relied on evidence we shouldn't have.
sentences.zh: 我们依赖了不该依赖的证据。

sentences.en: And we broke the rules when we prosecuted.
sentences.zh: 而且我们在起诉时违反了规则。

sentences.en: This wasn't an honest conviction.
sentences.zh: 这不是一次公正的定罪。

sentences.en: According to the prosecutor's office, they didn't set out to pick apart Adnan's case.
sentences.zh: 据检察官办公室称，他们并非刻意要拆解阿德南的案件。

sentences.en: Their own case, mind you.
sentences.zh: 请注意，这是他们自己的案件。

sentences.en: They say it just kind of crumbled once they took a hard look.
sentences.zh: 他们说，一旦他们深入调查，案件就自然而然地崩溃了。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: If you've heard season one of Serial, you know how I got there.
sentences.zh: 如果你听过《Serial》第一季，你就知道我是怎么得出这个结论的。

sentences.en: Here's how they got there.
sentences.zh: 以下是他们得出结论的过程。

sentences.en: Almost a year ago, a new law took effect in Maryland.
sentences.zh: 大约一年前，马里兰州生效了一项新法律。

sentences.en: The Juvenile Restoration Act.
sentences.zh: 《青少年恢复法案》。

sentences.en: One of the things the law says is that if you've served at least 20 years in prison for a crime you committed when you were a juvenile,
sentences.zh: 该法律规定，如果你因未成年时犯下的罪行在监狱中服刑至少20年，

sentences.en: you can ask the court to reduce your sentence, maybe even let you out.
sentences.zh: 你可以请求法院减刑，甚至可能让你获释。

sentences.en: So the day after this new law comes into effect, on October 2, 2021,
sentences.zh: 因此，在这项新法律生效后的第二天，即2021年10月2日，

sentences.en: Adnan's current attorney, Erica Suter, delivers his case over to the Baltimore City State's Attorney's Office for them to look at.
sentences.zh: 阿德南现在的律师埃里卡·苏特将他的案件移交给巴尔的摩市州检察官办公室进行审查。

sentences.en: Because, if you remember, Adnan was only 17 when he was arrested for killing Heyman Lee, his classmate and former girlfriend.
sentences.zh: 因为，如果你还记得的话，阿德南在因杀害同学兼前女友李海敏而被捕时年仅17岁。

sentences.en: This request goes to Becky Feldman, chief of the Sentencing Review Unit for the Prosecutor's Office.
sentences.zh: 此请求被提交给检察官办公室量刑审查部门负责人贝基·费尔德曼。

sentences.en: One of the factors she has to weigh in deciding whether to support a sentence reduction under this new law is the facts of the crime.
sentences.zh: 她在决定是否支持根据这项新法律减刑时，必须权衡的因素之一是犯罪事实。

sentences.en: So Becky Feldman starts reading.
sentences.zh: 于是贝基·费尔德曼开始阅读。

sentences.en: And pretty soon, she's bothered.
sentences.zh: 很快，她就感到不安了。

sentences.en: Something isn't right with the case.
sentences.zh: 这个案件有些不对劲。

sentences.en: She's having a hard time answering what should be a simple question.
sentences.zh: 她很难回答一个本应简单的问题。

sentences.en: What's Adnan Syed's level of culpability in this crime?
sentences.zh: 阿德南·赛义德在这起犯罪中的罪责程度是多少？

sentences.en: Becky Feldman is pretty new to the Prosecutor's Office.
sentences.zh: 贝基·费尔德曼在检察官办公室工作时间不长。

sentences.en: Pretty new to being a prosecutor.
sentences.zh: 担任检察官的时间也不长。

sentences.en: She'd been high up at the Public Defender's Office for years.
sentences.zh: 她曾在公设辩护人办公室担任高层多年。

sentences.en: Her sense of alarm was cultivated on the defense side.
sentences.zh: 她的警觉感是在辩护方培养出来的。

sentences.en: The Sentence Review isn't supposed to be a reinvestigation of a case, but that's what starts rolling.
sentences.zh: 量刑审查本不应是对案件的重新调查，但事情就是这样开始了。

sentences.en: By March, Becky's office, joined by Adnan's lawyer, asks a judge to order new high-tech DNA testing.
sentences.zh: 到了三月，贝基的办公室在阿德南律师的加入下，请求法官下令进行新的高科技DNA检测。

sentences.en: That takes a while to work through the system.
sentences.zh: 这在系统中处理需要一段时间。

sentences.en: So while they wait, Becky and Erica Suter work together, pulling threads.
sentences.zh: 所以在等待期间，贝基和埃里卡·苏特合作，抽丝剥茧。

sentences.en: Becky's office consults cell phone experts, a polygraph expert.
sentences.zh: 贝基的办公室咨询了手机专家和测谎专家。

sentences.en: She's all up inside Google Maps and land records.
sentences.zh: 她深入研究了谷歌地图和土地记录。

sentences.en: The state's massive case file is over at the Attorney General's office a few blocks away.
sentences.zh: 州政府庞大的案卷就在几个街区外的总检察长办公室。

sentences.en: Becky starts hoofing it over there in June.
sentences.zh: 六月份，贝基开始往那边跑。

sentences.en: The AG's office is like,
sentences.zh: 总检察长办公室的态度是，

sentences.en: 17 boxes of case materials, here's a copy machine, knock yourself out.
sentences.zh: 17箱案卷材料，复印机在那儿，你自己看着办吧。

sentences.en: She copies a bunch of stuff from the first seven boxes, takes the papers back to her office to read.
sentences.zh: 她从前七个箱子里复印了一堆东西，带回办公室阅读。

sentences.en: And that's when she discovers some handwritten notes.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，她发现了一些手写笔记。

sentences.en: They're messy, hard to make out.
sentences.zh: 笔记很乱，很难辨认。

sentences.en: But once she deciphers the writing, she realizes these notes are about a potential alternate suspect in the case.
sentences.zh: 但一旦她破译了字迹，她意识到这些笔记是关于案件中一名潜在的替代嫌疑人的。

sentences.en: She calls up Erica Suter, who tells her, yeah, we've never seen these notes before.
sentences.zh: 她打电话给埃里卡·苏特，对方告诉她，是的，我们以前从未见过这些笔记。

sentences.en: They're both shocked.
sentences.zh: 他们都惊呆了。

sentences.en: Once the DNA results came back in mid-August, with nothing really conclusive or useful, they took stock of everything they'd learned.
sentences.zh: 当DNA结果在8月中旬出来，且没有得出任何结论性或有用的信息时，他们评估了所学到的一切。

sentences.en: The result was a disturbing bouquet of problems, whose cumulative effect gave the state, quote,
sentences.zh: 结果是一系列令人不安的问题，其累积效应给了州政府，引用原话，

sentences.en: overwhelming cause for concern.
sentences.zh: “令人担忧的压倒性理由”。

sentences.en: Under the circumstances, they couldn't justify holding a nun in prison anymore.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，他们无法再证明将阿德南关在监狱里是正当的。

sentences.en: So Becky Feldman wrote a motion to the court, a motion to vacate.
sentences.zh: 于是贝基·费尔德曼向法院写了一份动议，即撤销动议。

sentences.en: The motion to vacate does not tell us a new story of the crime, doesn't lay out an alternate theory of who killed Heyman Lee.
sentences.zh: 撤销动议并没有讲述关于犯罪的新故事，也没有提出关于谁杀害了李海敏的替代理论。

sentences.en: Instead, the motion lays out how the system malfunctioned back then, and how little we know now.
sentences.zh: 相反，该动议阐述了当时的系统是如何失灵的，以及我们现在所知甚少。

sentences.en: The headline of the state's motion is that they've developed more evidence about two people who might have been involved in the crime,
sentences.zh: 州政府动议的标题是，他们已经掌握了更多关于两名可能涉案人员的证据，

sentences.en: but whom they say weren't properly ruled out as suspects.
sentences.zh: 但他们称这两名人员并未被适当地排除在嫌疑人之外。

sentences.en: They don't name these people.
sentences.zh: 他们没有透露这些人的名字。

sentences.en: They just call them the suspect or the suspects, because they say the investigation is ongoing.
sentences.zh: 他们只是称他们为嫌疑人，因为他们说调查仍在进行中。

sentences.en: They might have been involved together or separately.
sentences.zh: 他们可能是一起涉案，也可能是分别涉案。

sentences.en: They don't know.
sentences.zh: 他们不知道。

sentences.en: But both were known to detectives at the time.
sentences.zh: 但当时侦探们都知道这两个人。

sentences.en: The first thing, and worst thing, they list about these possible suspects, those handwritten notes Becky Feldman found in the state's trial boxes.
sentences.zh: 关于这些可能的嫌疑人，他们列出的第一件事，也是最严重的事，就是贝基·费尔德曼在州政府审判箱中发现的那些手写笔记。

sentences.en: They appear to be written by a prosecutor, memorializing two different phone calls from different people, who called the state's attorney's office
sentences.zh: 这些笔记似乎是由一名检察官写的，记录了来自不同人的两通不同电话，他们致电州检察官办公室

sentences.en: to give information about the same person.
sentences.zh: 提供关于同一个人的信息。

sentences.en: The notes aren't dated, but as best as Becky can tell, the calls came in several months apart and before a nun was tried.
sentences.zh: 笔记没有日期，但据贝基所知，这些电话相隔几个月，且在阿德南受审之前。

sentences.en: The gist of the information from both calls is that a guy the state had more or less overlooked had a motive to kill Heyman Lee,
sentences.zh: 两通电话信息的要点是，一个州政府或多或少忽略了的人有杀害李海敏的动机，

sentences.en: that this person was heard saying that he was upset with her and that he would, quote, make her disappear.
sentences.zh: 此人曾被听到说他对她很不满，并会，引用原话，“让她消失”。

sentences.en: He would kill her, unquote.
sentences.zh: “他会杀了她”，引用结束。

sentences.en: In court yesterday,
sentences.zh: 在昨天的法庭上，

sentences.en: Becky said the state had looked into this individual and found the information in those handwritten notes to be credible, that this suspect had the, quote,
sentences.zh: 贝基说州政府已经调查了此人，并发现那些手写笔记中的信息是可信的，该嫌疑人具有，引用原话，

sentences.en: motive, opportunity, and means to commit the crime.
sentences.zh: “犯罪的动机、机会和手段”。

sentences.en: Whether he did or he didn't, though, legally speaking, this would be a major breach.
sentences.zh: 然而，无论他是否真的做了，从法律上讲，这将是一个重大的违规行为。

sentences.en: If they failed to turn over evidence like this to the defense, that's known as a Brady violation.
sentences.zh: 如果他们未能将此类证据移交给辩方，这被称为布雷迪违规。

sentences.en: And that's what so alarms Becky Feldman, that it looks like Adnan's lawyers never knew about these calls.
sentences.zh: 这正是让贝基·费尔德曼感到震惊的地方，看起来阿德南的律师从未听说过这些电话。

sentences.en: That alone could be caused to overturn Adnan's conviction.
sentences.zh: 仅此一点就足以成为推翻阿德南定罪的理由。

sentences.en: So that's the biggest problem the motion explains, this Brady violation regarding one of the two alternate suspects the prosecutors are not naming.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是动议解释的最大问题，即关于检察官未点名的两名替代嫌疑人之一的布雷迪违规。

sentences.en: And the motion says they've also got other new information about these two suspects.
sentences.zh: 动议还称，他们还掌握了关于这两名嫌疑人的其他新信息。

sentences.en: One of them had a connection to the location where Heyman Lee's car was found after she disappeared.
sentences.zh: 其中一人与李海敏失踪后发现其汽车的地点有关联。

sentences.en: One or both of them have relevant criminal histories, mostly crimes committed after Adnan's trial.
sentences.zh: 他们中的一人或两人都有相关的犯罪记录，大多是阿德南受审后犯下的罪行。

sentences.en: One of them for a series of sexual assaults.
sentences.zh: 其中一人犯有一系列性侵犯罪行。

sentences.en: I know who these suspects are.
sentences.zh: 我知道这些人是谁。

sentences.en: One of them was investigated at the time, submitted to a couple of polygraphs.
sentences.zh: 其中一人在当时受到调查，并接受了几次测谎。

sentences.en: The other was investigated also, but not with much vigor as far as I can tell.
sentences.zh: 另一个人也受到了调查，但据我所知，力度不大。

sentences.en: He's now in prison for sexual assault.
sentences.zh: 他现在因性侵罪在监狱服刑。

sentences.en: But no one has charged either of these guys in connection with Heyman Lee's murder.
sentences.zh: 但没有人因李海敏的谋杀案起诉这两个人中的任何一个。

sentences.en: So I'm not going to name them either.
sentences.zh: 所以我也不会说出他们的名字。

sentences.en: That's all the new information they found about the case.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们针对此案发现的所有新信息。

sentences.en: But, the motion continues, they also looked at the old information.
sentences.zh: 但动议中继续写道，他们也重新审视了旧信息。

sentences.en: And now they're saying they've lost faith in that too.
sentences.zh: 现在他们表示，对那些旧信息也失去了信心。

sentences.en: They don't trust the state's main evidence at trial, the testimony of their star witness,
sentences.zh: 他们不再相信州政府在审判中的主要证据，即其明星证人的证词，

sentences.en: Jay Wilds, and the cell phone records.
sentences.zh: 也就是杰伊·怀尔兹（Jay Wilds）的证词，以及手机记录。

sentences.en: They don't hold up separately.
sentences.zh: 这些证据单独来看站不住脚。

sentences.en: They don't hold up together.
sentences.zh: 合在一起看也站不住脚。

sentences.en: If you've listened to our show, you probably remember all this.
sentences.zh: 如果你听过我们的节目，可能还记得这一切。

sentences.en: Jay was a friend of Adnan's who told the cops that Adnan said he was going to kill Hey.
sentences.zh: 杰伊是阿德南（Adnan）的朋友，他告诉警察，阿德南说他要杀了海（Hey）。

sentences.en: And that after he did it, he showed Jay her body in the trunk of a car and then coerced Jay into helping bury her in a wooded city park.
sentences.zh: 还说在杀人后，阿德南带杰伊看了后备箱里的尸体，然后强迫杰伊帮忙把她埋在城市的一片树林公园里。

sentences.en: The motion explains, as many people have before, that the details of Jay's story kept changing.
sentences.zh: 动议中解释说，正如许多人之前指出的那样，杰伊的故事细节一直在变。

sentences.en: Becky Feldman points to one glaring example, the location where Jay says Adnan first showed him Hey's body.
sentences.zh: 贝基·费尔德曼（Becky Feldman）指出了一个明显的例子，即杰伊声称阿德南第一次向他展示海的尸体的地点。

sentences.en: In his first taped interview with the detectives,
sentences.zh: 在与侦探的第一次录音访谈中，

sentences.en: Jay tells them he met up with Adnan somewhere along Edmondson Avenue.
sentences.zh: 杰伊告诉他们，他在埃德蒙森大道（Edmondson Avenue）的某个地方与阿德南会合。

sentences.en: And that's when he sees Hey's body in the trunk.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，他看到了后备箱里的海的尸体。

sentences.en: I went to pick him up from off of Edmondson Avenue.
sentences.zh: 我去埃德蒙森大道那边接他。

sentences.en: I would say it on Edmondson Avenue off of the strip.
sentences.zh: 我会说是在埃德蒙森大道，在那条街区外。

sentences.en: He records and he cross-straits on Edmondson Avenue where he gave me.
sentences.zh: 他记录了，他在埃德蒙森大道交叉口给了我。

sentences.en: I don't know him by name, but...
sentences.zh: 我不知道他的名字，但是……

sentences.en: A couple weeks later,
sentences.zh: 几周后，

sentences.en: Jay tells the cops he met up with Adnan and saw Hey's body in a different spot.
sentences.zh: 杰伊告诉警察，他在另一个地方与阿德南会合并看到了海的尸体。

sentences.en: And while en route to your house, you received a phone call from Adnan on his cell phone, which is in your possession.
sentences.zh: 在去你家的路上，你接到了阿德南打到他手机上的电话，而手机当时在你手里。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And the conversation was what?
sentences.zh: 谈话内容是什么？

sentences.en: That bitch is dead.
sentences.zh: 那个贱人死了。

sentences.en: Come and get me.
sentences.zh: 过来接我。

sentences.en: I'm at that spot.
sentences.zh: 我在那个地方。

sentences.en: And Jay's story has gotten even more confusing in the years since the trial.
sentences.zh: 自审判以来的这些年里，杰伊的故事变得更加令人困惑。

sentences.en: The motion notes that Jay told a reporter, not me, back in 2014, that he'd been out in front of his grandmother's house when Adnan came by and popped the trunk.
sentences.zh: 动议中提到，杰伊在2014年曾告诉一位记者（不是我），当时他正在他祖母家门前，阿德南开车过来并打开了后备箱。

sentences.en: At the trial, prosecutors kept saying to the jury, we know he's not the greatest witness.
sentences.zh: 在审判时，检察官一直对陪审团说，我们知道他不是最好的证人。

sentences.en: I do remember that when we first heard his testimony that we were all skeptical, like, who is this guy and where did he come from?
sentences.zh: 我确实记得当我们第一次听到他的证词时，我们都很怀疑，心想，这家伙是谁，他从哪冒出来的？

sentences.en: That's a juror named Lisa Flynn.
sentences.zh: 那是陪审员丽莎·弗林（Lisa Flynn）。

sentences.en: The prosecutors were telling the jury, don't worry, you don't have to rely on his testimony alone because what he's saying is corroborated by the cell phone records.
sentences.zh: 检察官当时告诉陪审团，别担心，你们不必只依赖他的证词，因为他的说法得到了手机记录的佐证。

sentences.en: Cell phone evidence was crucial to the state's case.
sentences.zh: 手机证据对州政府的案件至关重要。

sentences.en: It underpinned Jay's testimony about what happened that night, where they went, whom they spoke to.
sentences.zh: 它支撑了杰伊关于那天晚上发生了什么、他们去了哪里、他们和谁通过话的证词。

sentences.en: It glued together the timeline.
sentences.zh: 它将时间线粘合在了一起。

sentences.en: The cell phone evidence helped clear up the shagginess of Jay's story.
sentences.zh: 手机证据帮助理清了杰伊故事中的漏洞。

sentences.en: It was asking the records and, like, the cell phone records, you know, knowing that, okay, so even if he had lied, testimony proved that he was at this place at this time.
sentences.zh: 当时是在查记录，比如手机记录，你知道，心里想着，好吧，所以即使他撒了谎，证词也证明他在那个时间出现在那个地点。

sentences.en: But Becky Feldman wrote in last week's motion that the cell phone evidence at trial, it was unreliable.
sentences.zh: 但贝基·费尔德曼在上周的动议中写道，审判时的手机证据是不可靠的。

sentences.en: Adnan's defense team has been saying this for years, but the state only recently talked to three experts about what the cell records actually show and don't show.
sentences.zh: 阿德南的辩护团队多年来一直这么说，但州政府直到最近才就手机记录到底显示了什么、没显示什么，与三位专家进行了交谈。

sentences.en: And the experts all agreed, you can't use the incoming call records to back up Jay's narrative.
sentences.zh: 专家们一致认为，你不能用呼入记录来支持杰伊的叙述。

sentences.en: Doesn't work like that, for a host of reasons I won't bore you with.
sentences.zh: 行不通，原因有很多，我就不一一列举来烦你了。

sentences.en: We didn't get to the bottom of this incoming call problem back when we were reporting this story.
sentences.zh: 我们在报道这个故事时，并没有弄清这个呼入电话问题的真相。

sentences.en: At the end of the motion,
sentences.zh: 在动议的最后，

sentences.en: Becky Feldman tacked on a, by the way, final section about one of the two main detectives on the case,
sentences.zh: 贝基·费尔德曼附加了一个“顺便提一下”的最后部分，关于此案的两名主要侦探之一，

sentences.en: Bill Ritz.
sentences.zh: 比尔·里茨（Bill Ritz）。

sentences.en: He was accused of misconduct in another murder case that went to trial the same year Adnan did.
sentences.zh: 他被指控在阿德南受审同一年审理的另一宗谋杀案中存在不当行为。

sentences.en: In that case,
sentences.zh: 在那起案件中，

sentences.en: Detective Ritz was accused of manipulating evidence, fabricating evidence, not disclosing exculpatory evidence, not following up on evidence
sentences.zh: 里茨侦探被指控操纵证据、伪造证据、未披露无罪证据、未跟进证据，

sentences.en: that had pointed to a different suspect.
sentences.zh: 而那些证据指向了另一名嫌疑人。

sentences.en: In 2016, the guy convicted in that case was exonerated.
sentences.zh: 2016年，那起案件中被定罪的人被平反了。

sentences.en: Ritz was one of the two detectives who repeatedly interviewed Jay Wilds.
sentences.zh: 里茨是多次审问杰伊·怀尔兹的两名侦探之一。

sentences.en: So that's the bulk of the state's motion to vacate.
sentences.zh: 这就是州政府撤销动议的主要内容。

sentences.en: New information about two potential suspects, important evidence withheld from the defense, renewed suspicion of Jay's story, loss of confidence in the cell phone evidence.
sentences.zh: 关于两名潜在嫌疑人的新信息、向辩方隐瞒的重要证据、对杰伊故事的重新怀疑、对手机证据失去信心。

sentences.en: And while the Brady violation alone is enough for the state to cry uncle, all of it together, well, yes, overwhelming cause for concern.
sentences.zh: 虽然仅凭布雷迪违规（Brady violation）就足以让州政府认输，但所有这些加在一起，嗯，确实是令人担忧的压倒性理由。

sentences.en: Adnan's case was a mess, is a mess.
sentences.zh: 阿德南的案子是一团糟，现在也是一团糟。

sentences.en: That's pretty much where we were when we stopped reporting in 2014.
sentences.zh: 这基本就是我们2014年停止报道时的情况。

sentences.en: Baltimore City Police have told the prosecutor's office they're going to put someone back on the case.
sentences.zh: 巴尔的摩市警察局已告知检察官办公室，他们将重新指派人员负责此案。

sentences.en: Someone will try to talk to the two suspects
sentences.zh: 有人会尝试与贝基在动议中指出的

sentences.en: Becky identified in the motion.
sentences.zh: 两名嫌疑人进行交谈。

sentences.en: I have zero predictions about what could come of that.
sentences.zh: 对于会有什么结果，我没有任何预测。

sentences.en: But I do know that the chances of the state ever trying to prosecute Adnan again are remote at beSt.
sentences.zh: 但我确实知道，州政府再次尝试起诉阿德南的可能性微乎其微。

sentences.en: When Rabia Chowdhury first came to me about this case, I hadn't heard of it.
sentences.zh: 当拉比亚·乔杜里（Rabia Chowdhury）第一次带着这个案子来找我时，我还没听说过它。

sentences.en: No other journalists were looking at it.
sentences.zh: 没有其他记者在关注它。

sentences.en: Most of the reporting I did was to try to find out, obviously, who killed this young woman, but also, if everyone's doing their job right, how does a kid get convicted
sentences.zh: 我所做的大部分报道都是为了弄清楚，显然，是谁杀了这个年轻女子，但同时，如果每个人都在尽职尽责，一个孩子怎么会

sentences.en: on evidence this shaky?
sentences.zh: 仅凭如此站不住脚的证据就被定罪？

sentences.en: In the years since our story first aired,
sentences.zh: 在我们的报道首次播出后的几年里，

sentences.en: Rabia and others have pushed to find out more.
sentences.zh: 拉比亚和其他人一直在努力挖掘更多信息。

sentences.en: Now here come city prosecutors, and they're going even further.
sentences.zh: 现在市检察官来了，他们甚至走得更远。

sentences.en: And the picture that's emerged is this.
sentences.zh: 由此浮现出的图景是这样的。

sentences.en: Adnan's case contains just about every chronic problem our system can cough up.
sentences.zh: 阿德南的案子包含了我们司法系统能产生的几乎所有顽疾。

sentences.en: Police using questionable interview methods.
sentences.zh: 警察使用有问题的审讯方法。

sentences.en: Prosecutors keeping crucial evidence from the defense.
sentences.zh: 检察官向辩方隐瞒关键证据。

sentences.en: Slightly junky science.
sentences.zh: 略显粗糙的科学鉴定。

sentences.en: Extreme prison sentences.
sentences.zh: 极端的刑期。

sentences.en: Juveniles treated as adults.
sentences.zh: 未成年人被当作成年人对待。

sentences.en: How grindingly difficult it is to get your case back in court once you've been convicted.
sentences.zh: 一旦被定罪，想要让案件重回法庭是多么极其困难。

sentences.en: The Baltimore courtroom where Adnan's hearing was held is an old-school architectural gem.
sentences.zh: 举行阿德南听证会的巴尔的摩法庭是一座老派的建筑瑰宝。

sentences.en: You sit there hoping the massive chandelier is well secured.
sentences.zh: 你坐在那里，希望那巨大的吊灯安装得足够牢固。

sentences.en: The soaring ceilings are meant to inspire soaring thoughts.
sentences.zh: 高耸的天花板旨在激发高尚的思想。

sentences.en: About justice, presumably.
sentences.zh: 大概是关于正义的。

sentences.en: And fairness.
sentences.zh: 还有公平。

sentences.en: Fairness.
sentences.zh: 公平。

sentences.en: Yesterday, there was a lot of talk about fairness.
sentences.zh: 昨天，关于公平的讨论很多。

sentences.en: But most of what the state put in that motion to vacate, all the actual evidence, was either known or knowable to cops and prosecutors back in 1999.
sentences.zh: 但州政府在那份撤销动议中提出的绝大部分内容，所有实际证据，早在1999年警察和检察官就已经知道或可以知道了。

sentences.en: So even on a day when the government publicly recognizes its own mistakes, it's hard to feel cheered about a triumph of fairness.
sentences.zh: 所以，即使在政府公开承认自己错误的那一天，也很难为公平的胜利感到高兴。

sentences.en: Because we've built a system that takes more than 20 years to self-correct.
sentences.zh: 因为我们建立了一个需要20多年才能自我纠正的系统。

sentences.en: And that's just this one case.
sentences.zh: 而这还仅仅是这一个案子。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰（Benjamin Poulin）。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·朗森（Mark Ronson）。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》（The Reframers），这是一个关于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was
sentences.zh: 即使在我还在黑胶唱片时代

sentences.en: DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night, you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum
sentences.zh: 在夜店当DJ的时候，每天晚上，你都要带着300件你最珍贵的宝贝去上班，然后把DJ台变成一个像活生生的快闪博物馆一样的地方，

sentences.en: of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 陈列着美丽的50年历史的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼（Audemars Piguet）的《重构者》。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用

sentences.en: The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 《时报》一个月，而且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载

sentences.en: The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用内的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，免费获取30天的访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: After knocking out the electricity in Puerto Rico,
sentences.zh: 在摧毁了波多黎各的电力系统后，

sentences.en: Hurricane Fiona subjected the island to unrelenting rain and terrifying flash floods on Monday.
sentences.zh: 周一，飓风菲奥娜（Fiona）给该岛带来了持续不断的降雨和可怕的突发洪水。

sentences.en: Over the past two days, more than 30 inches of rain have fallen in some parts of Puerto Rico, requiring the emergency rescue of about 1,000 people.
sentences.zh: 在过去两天里，波多黎各部分地区的降雨量超过了30英寸，导致约1000人需要紧急救援。

sentences.en: And Queen Elizabeth II was laid to rest on Monday after a majestic state funeral
sentences.zh: 周一，伊丽莎白二世女王在庄严的国葬后入土为安，

sentences.en: that drew tens of millions of Britons together in a vast expression of grief and gratitude.
sentences.zh: 这场葬礼让数千万英国人沉浸在巨大的悲痛和感激之中。

sentences.en: Her late majesty famously declared on a 21st birthday broadcast that her whole life would be dedicated to serving the nation and commonwealth.
sentences.zh: 已故女王曾在21岁生日广播中发表名言，称她的一生将致力于服务国家和英联邦。

sentences.en: Rarely has such a promise been so well kept.
sentences.zh: 很少有这样的承诺能被如此完美地履行。

sentences.en: After a eulogy from the Archbishop of Canterbury, the Queen's coffin was lowered into the royal vault next to her late husband,
sentences.zh: 在坎特伯雷大主教发表悼词后，女王的灵柩被降入温莎城堡内一座教堂里，她已故丈夫菲利普亲王旁边的皇家墓室中。

sentences.en: Prince Philip, inside a chapel at Windsor Castle.
sentences.zh: 片刻之后，一位风笛手独自为女王致哀。

sentences.en: Moments later, a lone bagpiper paid tribute to the Queen.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》（The Daily）的内容。
